findings.title: Documented direct renderer invocation failed before preflight
findings.attack: Run python scripts/render_demo_video.py --check from the repository root.
findings.failure: The script could not import scripts.verify_demo_video because the repository root was absent from sys.path.
findings.repair: Bootstrap the repository root only for direct-script execution and retain normal package imports.
findings.validation: The direct command now emits the readiness object and the complete clean render executed through the same entry point.

findings.title: Dirty-source bypass weakened the exact-commit claim
findings.attack: Render with uncommitted changes while claiming a source commit.
findings.failure: An --allow-dirty option permitted bytes not represented by the claimed commit.
findings.repair: Remove the bypass and make a clean worktree a mandatory readiness condition.
findings.validation: Dirty readiness fails closed; source and tests contain no --allow-dirty surface.

findings.title: Video delivery was not authenticated by release archives or the standalone verifier
findings.attack: Substitute or omit generated video assets while preserving source archives and outer claims.
findings.failure: The partial packager copied root files but did not bind full/evidence archive copies or standalone verification.
findings.repair: Bind all six media files, verification metadata, source scripts, root copies, and full/evidence archive members; exclude generated media from source archives.
findings.validation: Packager and standalone-verifier tests authenticate root/archive equality and reject symlinked or incomplete media.

findings.title: Make targets resolved the expected commit as an empty Make variable
findings.attack: Run make video-doctor from a clean exact remote checkout.
findings.failure: $(git rev-parse HEAD) was interpreted by Make rather than the shell, yielding an empty expected SHA.
findings.repair: Resolve GIT_HEAD with $(shell git rev-parse HEAD) once per Make invocation and pass it to render and verify targets.
findings.validation: Dry-run and clean execution expose the exact 40-character remote SHA.

findings.title: Make command echo contaminated otherwise machine-readable JSON
findings.attack: Parse make video-doctor output as one JSON object.
findings.failure: Make printed the recipe before the JSON payload.
findings.repair: Silence video doctor, render, and verification recipes while preserving stderr and target failure semantics.
findings.validation: Target stdout is one JSON object; direct script retains exit 30 for invalid readiness.

findings.title: Renderer hard-coded one speech and image executable
findings.attack: Run on a host with espeak or convert but not espeak-ng or magick.
findings.failure: The renderer rejected otherwise compatible local tooling.
findings.repair: Select espeak-ng/espeak and magick/convert deterministically during non-mutating readiness.
findings.validation: Selected absolute tool paths are recorded in the source manifest and readiness receipt.

findings.title: Resolving the media directory before checking symlinks hid the alias
findings.attack: Supply a symlinked media directory to release packaging.
findings.failure: resolve() erased the fact that the caller supplied a symlink.
findings.repair: Reject the caller path as a symlink before strict resolution.
findings.validation: A dedicated negative test rejects symlinked media delivery.

findings.title: Narration called a hash-bound bundle signed
findings.attack: Compare spoken claims with implemented cryptographic guarantees.
findings.failure: The word signed overstated a SHA-256 integrity binding as a digital signature.
findings.repair: Use the precise phrase hash-bound bundle and prohibit signed bundle in tests.
findings.validation: Transcript and slide tests enforce conservative wording and benchmark limitations.
